outputs.Decision_and_explanation: PASS - Panel A is a spatial cluster image with no quantitative error bars or box/violin plots present.
PASS - Panel B shows H&E histology images with manual annotations; no error bars or box/violin plots present.
PASS - Panel C shows H&E images and spatial expression heatmaps; no error bars or box/violin plots present.
PASS - Panel D shows GSEA enrichment score line plots with NES/FDR/P values; these are not averaged data with error bars or box/violin plots, so none are required.

PASS - Panel E is a bar graph of log2 fold-change values (single value per gene from differential expression analysis) with p-values annotated; no error bars are shown and none are expected since each bar represents a single computed statistic, not a mean of replicates.
